mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without regime-specific conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase above 2.0% sustained for three months signals monetary tightening that elevates discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 2.0% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 2.0% for 3 months, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicate deteriorating consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both decline for 2 consecutive months, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising labor force participation (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) signals strong consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 100 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days without additional triggers.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 100, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100 for two months, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and labor force growth declines (FEDFUNDS rising and PAYEMS growth falling) indicate monetary tightening suppressing labor market activity, reducing consumer spending and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises and PAYEMS growth declines simultaneously, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 240), declining retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 240 and RSAFS declines, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.
